# Overview

This file prepares the England-wide dataset, the UN1 main analytical sample, and the UN1 + UF1 sensitivity sample.

## 1. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(stringr)

dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

mean_or_na <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

assert_unique <- function(data, key, object_name) {
  duplicated_keys <- data %>%
    count(.data[[key]], name = "n") %>%
    filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(duplicated_keys) > 0) {
    stop(object_name, " contains duplicate values in ", key)
  }
}

inverse_rescale <- function(x) {
  valid_range <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(valid_range)) || diff(valid_range) == 0) {
    stop("Cannot rescale a variable with no finite variation.")
  }
  1 - scales::rescale(x, to = c(0, 1), from = valid_range)
}
```

## 2. Load raw data

```{r load-data}
lookup <- read_csv(
  "data/raw/LSOA_2011_2021_lookup.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

economic <- read_csv(
  "data/raw/economic_inactivity_LSOA_2021.csv",
  skip = 7,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

imd <- read_excel(
  "data/raw/IMD2019_File2_DomainScores.xlsx",
  sheet = 2
)

emp_pt <- read_csv(
  "data/raw/accessibility_all/accessibility/employment/access_employment_pt.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(str_starts(geo_code, "E")) %>%
  select(geo_code, employment_45, employment_pct_45)

gp_pt <- read_csv(
  "data/raw/accessibility_all/accessibility/gp/access_gp_pt.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(str_starts(geo_code, "E")) %>%
  select(geo_code, gp_number_45, gp_pct_45)

supermarket_pt <- read_csv(
  "data/raw/accessibility_all/accessibility/supermarket/access_supermarkets_pt.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(str_starts(geo_code, "E")) %>%
  select(geo_code, supermarket_45, supermarket_pct_45)

student_raw <- read_csv(
  "data/raw/Student.csv",
  skip = 7,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  clean_names()

names(student_raw)

student_clean <- student_raw %>%
  select(
    lsoa21_code = mnemonic,
    inactive_student = economically_inactive_student
  ) %>%
  distinct(lsoa21_code, .keep_all = TRUE)

ruc <- read_csv(
  "data/raw/RUC_Data.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  select(LSOA21CD, RUC21CD, RUC21NM)

lsoa_sf <- st_read(
  "data/raw/Dissertation_shpfile/",
  quiet = TRUE
) %>%
  filter(str_starts(LSOA21CD, "E")) %>%
  st_make_valid()

assert_unique(emp_pt, "geo_code", "Employment PT data")
assert_unique(gp_pt, "geo_code", "GP PT data")
assert_unique(supermarket_pt, "geo_code", "Supermarket PT data")
assert_unique(ruc, "LSOA21CD", "RUC data")
assert_unique(st_drop_geometry(lsoa_sf), "LSOA21CD", "LSOA shapefile")

```

## 3. Reconcile IMD 2019 with 2021 LSOAs

```{r imd-link}
imd_2021 <- imd %>%
  left_join(lookup, by = c("LSOA code (2011)" = "LSOA11CD")) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(!is.na(lsoa21cd)) %>%
  group_by(lsoa21cd) %>%
  summarise(
    la_name_lookup = {
      values <- lad22nm[!is.na(lad22nm)]
      if (length(values) == 0) NA_character_ else values[[1]]
    },
    income_rank = mean_or_na(
      income_rank_where_1_is_most_deprived
    ),
    income_decile = mean_or_na(
      income_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as
    ),
    education_rank = mean_or_na(
      education_skills_and_training_rank_where_1_is_most_deprived
    ),
    education_decile = mean_or_na(
      education_skills_and_training_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as
    ),
    employment_rank = mean_or_na(
      employment_rank_where_1_is_most_deprived
    ),
    employment_decile = mean_or_na(
      employment_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as
    ),
    imd_rank = mean_or_na(
      index_of_multiple_deprivation_imd_rank_where_1_is_most_deprived
    ),
    imd_decile = mean_or_na(
      index_of_multiple_deprivation_imd_decile_where_1_is_most_deprived_10_percent_of_lso_as
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

assert_unique(imd_2021, "lsoa21cd", "IMD 2021-linked data")
```

## 4. Merge datasets

```{r merge}
economic_clean <- economic %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  select(
    lsoa21_code = mnemonic,
    lsoa_name = area,
    total_16_plus = total_all_usual_residents_aged_16_years_and_over,
    inactive_total = economically_inactive,
    inactive_longterm_sick = economically_inactive_long_term_sick_or_disabled
  ) %>%
  distinct(lsoa21_code, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    inactive_rate = inactive_total / total_16_plus,
    longterm_sick_rate = inactive_longterm_sick / total_16_plus,

    la_name = lsoa_name %>%
      str_remove("^lsoa2021:") %>%
      str_remove("\\s+\\d+[A-Z]+$") %>%
      str_squish()
  )

assert_unique(economic_clean, "lsoa21_code", "Economic inactivity data")

cleaned_access_final <- economic_clean %>%
  left_join(imd_2021, by = c("lsoa21_code" = "lsoa21cd")) %>%
  left_join(emp_pt, by = c("lsoa21_code" = "geo_code")) %>%
  left_join(gp_pt, by = c("lsoa21_code" = "geo_code")) %>%
  left_join(supermarket_pt, by = c("lsoa21_code" = "geo_code")) %>%
  left_join(ruc, by = c("lsoa21_code" = "LSOA21CD")) %>%
  left_join(student_clean, by = "lsoa21_code") %>%
  mutate(
    la_name = coalesce(la_name_lookup, la_name)
  ) %>%
  select(-la_name_lookup) %>%
  # Retain the common England-wide accessibility coverage used in the study.
  filter(!is.na(employment_45))

assert_unique(cleaned_access_final, "lsoa21_code", "Merged England dataset")
cat("Merged England-wide accessibility dataset:", nrow(cleaned_access_final), "LSOAs\n")
```

## 5. Construct scores

```{r scores}
cleaned_access_final <- cleaned_access_final %>%
  mutate(
    income_score = inverse_rescale(income_decile),
    education_score = inverse_rescale(education_decile),
    deprivation_score = (income_score + education_score) / 2,

    emp_score = inverse_rescale(log1p(employment_45)),
    gp_score = inverse_rescale(log1p(gp_number_45)),
    supermarket_score = inverse_rescale(log1p(supermarket_45)),

    mean_access_disadvantage =
      (emp_score + gp_score + supermarket_score) / 3,

    inactive_student_rate = inactive_student / total_16_plus,
    student_share_of_inactive = if_else(
      inactive_total > 0,
      inactive_student / inactive_total,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

cleaned_access_final %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    student_matched = sum(!is.na(inactive_student)),
    student_missing = sum(is.na(inactive_student)),
    mean_student_rate = mean(inactive_student_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_student_share = mean(student_share_of_inactive, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

student_validation <- economic_clean %>%
  select(
    lsoa21_code,
    total_old = total_16_plus,
    inactive_old = inactive_total
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    student_raw %>%
      transmute(
        lsoa21_code = mnemonic,
        total_new = total_all_usual_residents_aged_16_years_and_over,
        inactive_new = economically_inactive,
        inactive_student = economically_inactive_student
      ),
    by = "lsoa21_code"
  )

student_validation %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    total_identical = all(total_old == total_new, na.rm = TRUE),
    inactive_identical = all(inactive_old == inactive_new, na.rm = TRUE),
    student_min = min(inactive_student, na.rm = TRUE),
    student_median = median(inactive_student, na.rm = TRUE),
    student_mean = mean(inactive_student, na.rm = TRUE),
    student_max = max(inactive_student, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```

## 6. Analytical samples and low-accessibility dimensions

```{r samples-and-thresholds}
main_required <- c(
  "la_name", "inactive_rate",
  "employment_45", "gp_number_45", "supermarket_45",
  "emp_score", "gp_score", "supermarket_score"
)

un1_base <- cleaned_access_final %>%
  filter(RUC21CD == "UN1") %>%
  drop_na(all_of(main_required))

un1_uf1_base <- cleaned_access_final %>%
  filter(RUC21CD %in% c("UN1", "UF1")) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(main_required))

thr_emp_un1 <- quantile(un1_base$emp_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
thr_gp_un1 <- quantile(un1_base$gp_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
thr_sup_un1 <- quantile(un1_base$supermarket_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)

thr_emp_sens <- quantile(un1_uf1_base$emp_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
thr_gp_sens <- quantile(un1_uf1_base$gp_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
thr_sup_sens <- quantile(un1_uf1_base$supermarket_score, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)

thresholds <- list(
  main_un1 = c(
    employment = unname(thr_emp_un1),
    gp = unname(thr_gp_un1),
    supermarket = unname(thr_sup_un1)
  ),
  sensitivity_un1_uf1 = c(
    employment = unname(thr_emp_sens),
    gp = unname(thr_gp_sens),
    supermarket = unname(thr_sup_sens)
  )
)

print(thresholds)
```

```{r flags}
cleaned_access_final <- cleaned_access_final %>%
  mutate(
    is_un1 = RUC21CD == "UN1",
    is_un1_uf1 = RUC21CD %in% c("UN1", "UF1"),

    low_employment_accessibility = emp_score >= thr_emp_un1,
    low_gp_accessibility = gp_score >= thr_gp_un1,
    low_supermarket_accessibility = supermarket_score >= thr_sup_un1,

    n_low_access_dimensions_num =
      as.integer(low_employment_accessibility) +
      as.integer(low_gp_accessibility) +
      as.integer(low_supermarket_accessibility),

    n_low_access_dimensions = factor(
      n_low_access_dimensions_num,
      levels = 0:3
    ),

    low_employment_accessibility_sens = emp_score >= thr_emp_sens,
    low_gp_accessibility_sens = gp_score >= thr_gp_sens,
    low_supermarket_accessibility_sens = supermarket_score >= thr_sup_sens,

    n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num =
      as.integer(low_employment_accessibility_sens) +
      as.integer(low_gp_accessibility_sens) +
      as.integer(low_supermarket_accessibility_sens),

    n_low_access_dimensions_sens = factor(
      n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num,
      levels = 0:3
    )
  )

un1_analytic <- cleaned_access_final %>%
  filter(is_un1) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(main_required), n_low_access_dimensions_num)

un1_uf1_analytic <- cleaned_access_final %>%
  filter(is_un1_uf1) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(main_required), n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num)

assert_unique(un1_analytic, "lsoa21_code", "UN1 analytical sample")
assert_unique(un1_uf1_analytic, "lsoa21_code", "UN1 + UF1 analytical sample")

stopifnot(all(un1_analytic$n_low_access_dimensions_num %in% 0:3))
stopifnot(all(un1_uf1_analytic$n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num %in% 0:3))

cat("Main analytical sample (UN1):", nrow(un1_analytic), "LSOAs\n")
cat("Sensitivity sample (UN1 + UF1):", nrow(un1_uf1_analytic), "LSOAs\n\n")

cat("Main-sample low-accessibility shares:\n")
un1_analytic %>%
  summarise(
    employment = mean(low_employment_accessibility) * 100,
    gp = mean(low_gp_accessibility) * 100,
    supermarket = mean(low_supermarket_accessibility) * 100
  ) %>%
  print()

cat("\nMain-sample dimension distribution:\n")
un1_analytic %>%
  count(n_low_access_dimensions, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  print()

cat("\nSensitivity-sample dimension distribution:\n")
un1_uf1_analytic %>%
  count(n_low_access_dimensions_sens, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  print()

cleaned_access_final %>%
  filter(la_name == "County Durham") %>%
  count(RUC21CD, RUC21NM)
```

## 7. Spatial dataset

```{r spatial}
lsoa_attributes <- cleaned_access_final %>%
  select(
    lsoa21_code, la_name,
    inactive_rate, longterm_sick_rate,
    deprivation_score,
    mean_access_disadvantage,
    emp_score, gp_score, supermarket_score,
    low_employment_accessibility,
    low_gp_accessibility,
    low_supermarket_accessibility,
    n_low_access_dimensions_num,
    n_low_access_dimensions,
    low_employment_accessibility_sens,
    low_gp_accessibility_sens,
    low_supermarket_accessibility_sens,
    n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num,
    n_low_access_dimensions_sens,
    is_un1, is_un1_uf1,
    employment_45,
    RUC21CD, RUC21NM
  )

lsoa_map <- lsoa_sf %>%
  left_join(
    lsoa_attributes,
    by = c("LSOA21CD" = "lsoa21_code")
  )

assert_unique(st_drop_geometry(lsoa_map), "LSOA21CD", "Spatial LSOA dataset")
```

## 8. Validation and save

```{r validation-save}
stopifnot(
  nrow(un1_analytic) == n_distinct(un1_analytic$lsoa21_code),
  nrow(un1_uf1_analytic) == n_distinct(un1_uf1_analytic$lsoa21_code),
  sum(is.na(un1_analytic$n_low_access_dimensions_num)) == 0,
  sum(is.na(un1_uf1_analytic$n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num)) == 0
)

cat("cleaned_access_final:", nrow(cleaned_access_final), "rows\n")
cat("lsoa_map:", nrow(lsoa_map), "rows\n")
cat("un1_analytic:", nrow(un1_analytic), "rows\n")
cat("un1_uf1_analytic:", nrow(un1_uf1_analytic), "rows\n")

saveRDS(cleaned_access_final, "data/processed/cleaned_access_final.rds")
saveRDS(lsoa_map, "data/processed/lsoa_map.rds")
saveRDS(un1_analytic, "data/processed/un1_analytic.rds")
saveRDS(un1_uf1_analytic, "data/processed/un1_uf1_analytic.rds")
saveRDS(thresholds, "data/processed/accessibility_thresholds.rds")

cat("All data-preparation outputs saved.\n")
```
